laws.rule: Bologna's 2026 tourist tax (imposta di soggiorno) per person per night depends on the room price per person excluding VAT: EUR 4 up to EUR 30.99, EUR 5.80 up to EUR 70.99, EUR 6.50 up to EUR 120.99 and EUR 7 above that (about A$6.36 to A$11.12, RBA rate of 30 October 2026); EUR 2.80 at campsites and hostels.
